amplitude_rigidity.definitions: Let A_N=sqrt(3C_N), D_N(phi)=phi_N^2-A_N^2 and W_N=||D_N(phi)||_2^2 on normalized T3
amplitude_rigidity.configuration_bound: Every cutoff configuration satisfies |||phi_N|-A_N||_2^2<=W_N/(3C_N), with no Gaussian, sign, moment or likelihood assumption
amplitude_rigidity.state_bound: For every probability law nu, E_nu |||phi_N|-A_N||_2^2<=E_nu W_N/(3C_N)
amplitude_rigidity.quadratic_endpoint: If C_N>=c_C N^2 and E_nu W_N<=K N^2, the expected squared amplitude error is at most K/(3c_C)=O(1), whereas the target amplitude has squared norm A_N^2=Theta(N^2)
amplitude_rigidity.interpretation: An order-N2 Wick expectation freezes amplitude but not sign: the surviving degree of freedom is the spatial sign field s_phi=sgn(phi_N), not an ordinary small covariance around one fixed well
amplitude_rigidity.scope_guard: Amplitude rigidity alone gives neither a small-ball exponent nor a Dirichlet-capacity bound and does not exclude spatially sign-changing ultraviolet textures
